title: Pure Ally of Justice
summary: Ally of Justice is a DARK Machine Synchro archetype designed to counter LIGHT monsters and face-down defenses. Using DNA Transplant to force the opponent's board into the LIGHT Attribute, the deck unlocks devastating removal from Quarantine, Cycle Reader, and Decisive Armor.

allow.Black Salvo: Level 3 DARK Machine Tuner that revives a Level 4 DARK Machine like Garadholg for an instant Level 7 Synchro.
allow.Machina Gearframe: Searches Machina Fortress and provides reliable Machine Normal Summon presence.
allow.Machina Fortress: Discards high-level Ally of Justice monsters to Special Summon itself as Synchro fodder or beatdown.
allow.DNA Transplant: Continuous Trap that changes all monsters on the field to LIGHT, enabling all Ally of Justice anti-LIGHT effects.

main: Ally of Justice Cycle Reader
Level 3 Tuner handtrap that banishes up to 2 LIGHT monsters from the opponent's GY as a Quick Effect.
Ally of Justice Quarantine
Floodgate monster that prevents both players from Special Summoning LIGHT monsters.
Ally of Justice Core Destroyer
Automatically destroys any LIGHT monster it battles at the start of the Damage Step.
Ally of Justice Garadholg
Level 4 DARK Machine that gains ATK when battling LIGHT monsters and pairs with Black Salvo.
Ally of Justice Thousand Arms
Can attack all face-up LIGHT monsters the opponent controls once each.
Ally of Justice Reverse Break
Automatically destroys face-down Defense Position monsters at the start of the Damage Step.
Ally Mind
Level 5 DARK Machine Normal Tuner used for high-level Synchro climbs into Decisive Armor.
Black Salvo
Revives Garadholg or Core Destroyer on Normal Summon for an instant Synchro Summon.
Machina Gearframe
Searches Machina Fortress on Normal Summon to extend Machine plays.
Machina Fortress
Special Summons itself from hand or GY by discarding Machine monsters totaling Level 8 or more.
DNA Transplant
Declares LIGHT to turn all opposing monsters into valid targets for Ally of Justice effects.
extra: Iconic Level 5 Synchro that automatically destroys any non-DARK monster it battles.
Level 10 Synchro boss that destroys Set cards, wipes opposing hands of LIGHT monsters, or burns for game.
Level 9 Synchro that cannot be Special Summoned except by Synchro and draws a card when destroying defense monsters.
Level 8 Synchro that gains 200 ATK for every LIGHT monster in the opponent's GY.
